translated_title: Water as a Right: Sheinbaum Reports Recovery of 5 Billion Cubic Meters
original_title: Agua como derecho: Sheinbaum reporta recuperación de 5 mil millones de metros cúbicos
author: Fernanda Monroy
meta_description: Following the reform to the National Water Law, Mexico has recovered over 5 billion cubic meters of water from private concessions—enough to supply 90 million people for a year. President Sheinbaum detailed river cleanups, irrigation upgrades, and 17 strategic water projects.
